# Implementation browser QA

October 16, 2026 · synthetic draft on a disposable localhost origin at port 43210. No real student record was used, and no assessment was submitted on the official public origin.

| Flow | Observed outcome |
| --- | --- |
| Three homepage entrances | Career search, discovery, and assessment-result import render with grouped navigation. |
| Derived Mini-IP display `4/4/4/10/4/4` | Explicit provider-display state remains discussion only after source/date/review entry; it cannot establish raw interest themes. |
| Raw form with wrong 0–10 scale | Online 30-item form requires raw 0–20; changing representation withdraws verification. |
| Raw `0/0/0/20/0/0` | Numeric zeros persist after reload. Reviewed raw record is ready, and only Social appears among interest themes. |
| Provider-returned occupations | Separate source/date/check fields record a psychiatric-technician return as attributed to the provider. It remains visible when local interest representation is provider-display. |
| Alias search | “mental health worker” finds psychiatric aides and technicians, with each alternate-title match shown. Search focus survives filtering. |
| Save versus compare | Saving a psychiatric aide and separately adding three distinct occupations to comparison uses independent controls and persists. |
| Three psychiatric roles | Comparison distinguishes tasks and preparation groups 1–2, 3, and 5. It retains explicit unavailable local finance/legal facts. Latest sourced distributions replace earlier placeholder data; no object-string rendering remains. |
| Student/counselor output | Student brief keeps evidence details collapsed; counselor view expands evidence cards and exposes source-linked explanations. Privacy is off by default. |
| Set aside from report | Removed aide card disappears; focus moves to the surviving technician choice select, its disclosure stays open, and a status toast explains how to revisit the role. |
| Explicit ordering | Moving software to the front places it first while retaining its discovery attribution. Keyboard focus returns to the moved control in an open disclosure. |
| Suggested next experiment | After candidate changes, the top brief reflects the selected or first occupation, rather than an unrelated generic direction. |

The browser extension did not apply the requested phone viewport reliably. One raw emulation attempt timed out; the override was cleared. Therefore no successful 390×844 visual verification is claimed. Responsive grid/stack rules are present and were inspected. See the separate questionnaire QA record for journey, follow-up, planner, and restore checks, including its export-download event limitation. Print styles are present; an exported PDF pagination audit was not completed. These checks are functional software evidence, not accessibility certification, participant usability evidence, or psychometric validation.
